arStrings.szText: {c_important}Terror Swarm{/c} is now additionally a {c_important}Recast{/c} Skill and stays in place, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_RECAST}{/c} damage per hit. Recast while active to command the swarm to move to your target.

{c_important}Terror Swarm{/c} starts smaller and weaker but grows up to {c_number}{SF_18}{/c} times as it feeds on enemies. Upon reaching maximum size, swarms split off another smaller swarm. Can have up to {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} active swarms.
{c_important}Terror Swarm{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and stays around you, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_AURA}{/c} damage per hit.
{c_important}Terror Swarm{/c} now bites up to {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} additional times per second.
{c_important}Terror Swarm{/c} makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} and causes them to take {c_number}[{SF_24}*100|%|]{/c} increased damage from your {c_important}Archfiend{/c} Skills.
{c_important}Terror Swarm{/c} periodically Pulls enemies into the center of the swarm.
{c_important}Terror Swarm{/c} spawns and instantly kills {c_number}{SF_25}{/c} {c_important}Lesser Demons{/c} every second.
